change: Reference observations with selected-side critical evidence must have one nonblank tracked subject identity. Multiple identities fail closed and are fatal to automatic fit/backend recovery.
limits: Tracked IDs are provenance, not biometric identities. Reusing one ID for different actual people is not detected by this guard.
Different segments with the same tracked identity are not automatically treated as different people.
The trusted ActionProfile overload cannot recover missing subject information from an already compiled profile; the production upload path uses sequence compilation.
The existing camera adapter supplies one person; this check also protects typed/alternative observation providers.
No new independent precision result or readiness point is earned merely by adding this guard.
